description: Exact complete physical source inputs for Acclimate, Dare, Flow, Revered, Wander and Crystallize; Bless scope reuses its existing complete linked-face fixture. Authored equivalent inputs remain native unverified.

subrules.name: 701.79b
subrules.rule: As a permanent acclimates, its controller may reveal a Weather card they own from outside the game or in their graveyard and put it into their hand. If they don't, they put a +1/+1 counter on that permanent.

subrules.name: 701.79c
subrules.rule: If an effect instructs a player to acclimate, they may reveal a Weather card they own from outside the game or in their graveyard and put it into their hand. If they don't, they put a +1/+1 counter on a creature they control.

mechanics.original_reminder: You may put a Weather card from your graveyard or outside the game into your hand, or put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.

subrules.name: 701.74a
subrules.rule: Certain abilities instruct a permanent to “dare N.” Until end of turn, that permanent becomes legendary, a Rebel creature in addition to its other types, and has base power and toughness N/N.

mechanics.original_reminder: It becomes a legendary Rebel with base power and toughness 5/5 in addition to its other types until end of turn.
mechanics.executable_reminder: It becomes a legendary Rebel creature with base power and toughness 5/5 in addition to its other types until end of turn.

semantic_equivalence.evidence: Revolution701.74a explicitly adds legendary,Rebel creature and N/N base stats until endofturn,retaining existing types. Existing animation/continuous effects suffice; dynamicN declaration must be bound.

subrules.rule: Revered is a static ability. "Revered" means "Each other creature you control that has one or more counters on it has the abilities printed below this one." Some cards with revered also have abilities printed before the revered ability, which are not granted to other creatures.

executable_definitions.reminder: Do the following: [You may put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control. If you don't, create a Treasure token.].
